headline: Two guards, one grave: Lode Runner's chain pay goes live
lede: THE ROPE in LODE RUNNER-LITE now hunts with a pair, and the original's trap ladder finally pays its double in actual play — dig the right shaft and one closing brick buries both orange hunters at once.

notes.text: Vault 2 of LODE RUNNER-LITE gained a second guard on the far wing. Same kit, same physics, independent hunt — and the diggable hall between the wings makes the machine's signature reachable: carve the two-cell shaft by the ladder, let both hunters ride the mouth into it, and the closing brick pays 1500 (double, plus the depth premium) where a single grave pays 1000.

The audit grew a live-chain scenario: a scripted stream from the REAL spawn, no hand-placed bodies — both wings must pursue, both must fall, and a new mutant (rope back to one guard) must die. 125 checks plain, 153 with mutants, all fourteen dead; the WATCH seat and attract witness re-proven clean with both hunters live.
Papers, Please-Min shipped its one-off crowd the same shift (hats, unibrows, earrings, missing teeth) — the shelf's two newest titles both got their top honest gap dug out between them.

look.text: Dig the col-9 double grave in THE ROPE — vault 2 of LODE RUNNER-LITE
